title: What's New: Autofill Fields with Copilot (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Creating a customer record with autofill suggestions
Understanding suggestion mechanisms and user control
Business Central validation and field logic overrides
Creating a fixed asset with keyboard shortcuts

features.name: Copilot autofill for card and document pages
features.description: Copilot suggests values for blank fields in cards and document pages, allowing users to avoid manual lookups and data entry. It provides visually distinct suggestions within fast tabs.
caveats: Suggestions are not automatically saved; user must explicitly choose to keep them
Business Central field validation and AL-based logic overrides Copilot suggestions

features.name: Most recently used and most frequently used selection
features.description: Copilot suggests values based on what was most recently or most frequently used in the company, helping users avoid redundant lookups.

features.name: Intelligent lookup selection from predefined choices
features.description: Copilot intelligently selects values from lookup and option fields based on context of other fields in the record, such as selecting the responsibility center closest to a customer's country.

features.name: Web search for public information
features.description: Copilot can search the web powered by Bing to fill in public information like customer addresses, phone numbers, and email addresses without requiring manual browsing.
features.status_evidence_quote: but do note that the ability to search the web will be available later during the wave
caveats: Web search capability will be available later during the wave, not in initial update 26 release

features.name: Keyboard shortcut for autofill (Alt+I)
features.description: Users can press Alt+I to ask Copilot to fill out a field and related fields within a fast tab. The feature integrates with Business Central's keyboard navigation.

features.name: Quick entry integration with Copilot
features.description: Copilot autofill works seamlessly with quick entry feature. Users can press Enter to accept suggestions and move to the next field, similar to existing quick entry behavior.

features.name: Copilot suggestion explanation tooltips
features.description: When Copilot provides a suggestion, users can click an info icon to see why the suggestion was made, such as for proper formatting or frequency analysis.

features.name: AI foundational model suggestions
features.description: When other mechanisms like recent/frequent use or lookups do not apply, Copilot uses its foundational AI training to generate contextual suggestions, such as suggesting a five-year depreciation life for inkjet printers.

features.name: Unsaved suggestion reminder
features.description: When leaving a page with unapplied Copilot suggestions, Business Central reminds the user of suggestions not yet reviewed, allowing explicit choice to keep or discard.

features.name: Copilot support for custom fields and pages
features.description: Copilot autofill works with custom fields and custom pages without requiring developers or partners to write extensibility code or modifications.
caveats: Developers can read documentation to understand how to influence and improve Copilot output for custom fields
